_comment: osa script registry. α-3a seeded 3 scripts; β-1 adds 10 more. All tier-2+ entries require a capability token at dispatch time (see lib/hal/osa/auth.py). Pattern constraints and max_length are council-mandated for injection-safety.

battery_get.body: do shell script "pmset -g batt | grep -Eo '[0-9]+%' | head -1"

volume_get.body: return output volume of (get volume settings)

notification_with_subtitle.description: Display a macOS local notification with a subtitle line.

frontmost_app_get.description: Return the name of the frontmost application.
frontmost_app_get.body: tell application "System Events" to return name of first application process whose frontmost is true

idle_time_get.description: Return seconds since last user input (keyboard/mouse).
idle_time_get.body: return (do shell script "ioreg -c IOHIDSystem | awk '/HIDIdleTime/ {print int($NF/1000000000); exit}'") as integer

display_count_get.description: Return the number of connected displays.
display_count_get.body: tell application "Finder" to return count of displays of (get desktop picture info)

clipboard_get.description: Return the current clipboard text contents. Tier 2 — clipboard may contain secrets.

screen_lock.description: Lock the current user session (sleep display).
screen_lock.body: tell application "System Events" to keystroke "q" using {control down, command down}

dark_mode_toggle.description: Toggle the system appearance between light and dark mode.
dark_mode_toggle.body: tell application "System Events" to tell appearance preferences to set dark mode to not dark mode

caffeinate_start.description: Prevent the Mac from sleeping for a bounded interval (1-99999 seconds, up to ~27h — covers the GRIP /mac morning 8h boot ritual and /mac watch 3h stream; previous 1h cap silently rejected both).

dnd_status_get.description: Return 1 if Focus/Do Not Disturb is active, 0 otherwise.
dnd_status_get.body: do shell script "defaults -currentHost read com.apple.notificationcenterui doNotDisturb 2>/dev/null || echo 0"

speak.description: Speak a short message using the system voice.

tab_close_chromium_by_url.description: Close all tabs whose URL contains a given substring, in a Chromium-family browser (Chrome/Arc/Brave/Edge/Chromium/Vivaldi/Opera). Returns closed count as string.
tab_close_chromium_by_url.body:
tell application {browser}
  set closedCount to 0
  repeat with w in windows
    set tabList to tabs of w
    repeat with i from (count of tabList) to 1 by -1
      set t to item i of tabList
      if URL of t contains {url_pattern} then
        close t
        set closedCount to closedCount + 1
      end if
    end repeat
  end repeat
  return closedCount
end tell

findmy_process_probe.description: Probe whether the FindMy process is running. Returns 'FindMy' on success; raises an osascript error if the UI-automation permission is missing or the process is absent. Used by GRIP findmy_reader to verify Accessibility reachability.
findmy_process_probe.body: tell application "System Events" to get name of first process whose name is "FindMy"

findmy_status.description: Return GRIP Find My's address-free status: one line per watched device or item with its state (moving, parked, with you, stale), how long ago Find My last saw it and its distance from the owner's iPhone. It reads GRIP's own state through `grip-find-my status --brief`; it never drives Find My, never activates an app and never sends a keystroke. When GRIP Find My is not installed on this Mac (no GRIP, or a GRIP too old to have it), the shell exits 3 with a one-line reason; `do shell script` raises that as AppleScript error 3, so osascript prints the reason ending in "(3)" and exits 1.
findmy_status.body: do shell script "d=\"${CLAUDE_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}\"; if [ -x \"$d/bin/grip-find-my\" ]; then exec \"$d/bin/grip-find-my\" status --brief; fi; echo 'find-my: GRIP Find My is not installed on this Mac' >&2; exit 3"

crash_dialog_detect.description: Detect an active macOS crash-reporter dialog. Returns 'Problem Reporter' | 'UserNotificationCenter' | 'none'. Used by GRIP crash-watchdog to decide whether to dismiss.
crash_dialog_detect.body:
tell application "System Events"
  set crashApps to {"Problem Reporter", "UserNotificationCenter"}
  repeat with appName in crashApps
    if exists process appName then
      try
        set winCount to count of windows of process appName
        if winCount > 0 then
          return appName as text
        end if
      end try
    end if
  end repeat
  return "none"
end tell

crash_dialog_dismiss.description: Dismiss a macOS crash-reporter dialog by clicking OK/Reopen/Close (first available), or sending Escape as a last resort. Process name is whitelist-validated to the two known crash-reporter apps.
crash_dialog_dismiss.body:
tell application "System Events"
  try
    tell process {process_name}
      if exists button "OK" of window 1 then
        click button "OK" of window 1
      else if exists button "Reopen" of window 1 then
        click button "Reopen" of window 1
      else if exists button "Close" of window 1 then
        click button "Close" of window 1
      else
        key code 53
      end if
    end tell
  end try
end tell

tier3_test_echo.description: γ-2a + γ-2b end-to-end harness. Returns a static string so the consent + audit-redaction + rate-limit path is exercisable without real external effects. NOT intended for production dispatch — used by tests and operator dry-runs.

mute_status_get.description: Return 'true' if system output is muted, 'false' otherwise.
mute_status_get.body: return output muted of (get volume settings) as text

app_launch.description: Launch (or activate if already running) a named application.

clipboard_set.description: Set the clipboard to a plain-text string.

screen_wake.description: Wake the display if it is sleeping (sends a harmless mouse jiggle via System Events).
screen_wake.body: tell application "System Events" to key code 63

music_play.description: Start playback in Music.app (or resume if paused).

music_next_track.description: Skip to the next track in Music.app.

music_previous_track.description: Go back to the previous track in Music.app.

music_now_playing.description: Return 'Artist – Title' of the currently playing track in Music.app, or 'nothing playing' if paused/stopped.
music_now_playing.body:
tell application "Music"
  if player state is playing then
    set t to current track
    return (artist of t) & " - " & (name of t)
  else
    return "nothing playing"
  end if
end tell

shortcut_run.description: Run a named Apple Shortcut via Shortcuts.app. Optional input string passed to the Shortcut.

imessage_send.description: Send an iMessage to a phone number or email handle via Messages.app.
imessage_send.body:
tell application "Messages"
  set targetBuddy to buddy {handle} of (first service whose service type = iMessage)
  send {text} to targetBuddy
end tell

sleep_now.description: Put the Mac to sleep immediately. Tier-3 — always requires explicit confirmation.

shutdown.description: Shut down the Mac. Tier-3 — always requires explicit confirmation.
shutdown.body: tell application "System Events" to shut down

restart.description: Restart the Mac. Tier-3 — always requires explicit confirmation.

open_url_fullscreen.description: Open a web URL in the default browser and put that window into fullscreen. Every failure path returns a documented outcome string rather than raising: 'opening FAILED (<reason>)' if the browser cannot be invoked, otherwise 'opened fullscreen in <app>', 'opened in <app>; fullscreen NOT confirmed', or 'opened; fullscreen unverified (<reason>)'. The fullscreen result is VERIFIED by reading the frontmost window's AXFullScreen attribute, never inferred from the keystroke not raising, and the outcome names the app that actually received it.
open_url_fullscreen.body:
set outcome to "opened; fullscreen NOT attempted"
try
  open location {url}
on error errMsg
  return "opening FAILED (" & errMsg & ")"
end try
delay 1.5
try
  tell application "System Events"
    set frontApp to first application process whose frontmost is true
    keystroke "f" using {command down, control down}
    delay 0.7
    set isFull to value of attribute "AXFullScreen" of front window of frontApp
    if isFull is true then
      set outcome to "opened fullscreen in " & (name of frontApp)
    else
      set outcome to "opened in " & (name of frontApp) & "; fullscreen NOT confirmed"
    end if
  end tell
on error errMsg
  set outcome to "opened; fullscreen unverified (" & errMsg & ")"
end try
return outcome

cast_url_catt.description: Cast a web URL to a Chromecast/Google TV device using the `catt` CLI. Optional `device` selects a named target; empty (the default) uses catt's own default device, which is non-deterministic when several are present. Requires catt to be installed (pipx install catt) and raises error number 1001 naming the searched locations if it is absent. A failing cast returns 'cast FAILED (<reason>)' rather than raising. Returns 'casting' on success.
cast_url_catt.body:
set cattPath to ""
repeat with candidate in {"/opt/homebrew/bin/catt", "/usr/local/bin/catt", (POSIX path of (path to home folder)) & ".local/bin/catt"}
  try
    do shell script "test -x " & quoted form of (candidate as text)
    set cattPath to candidate as text
    exit repeat
  end try
end repeat
if cattPath is "" then
  error "catt is not installed (looked in /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, ~/.local/bin). Install it with: pipx install catt" number 1001
end if
set deviceArg to ""
if {device} is not "" then
  set deviceArg to " -d " & quoted form of {device}
end if
try
  do shell script quoted form of cattPath & " cast" & deviceArg & " " & quoted form of {url}
on error errMsg
  return "cast FAILED (" & errMsg & ")"
end try
return "casting"
